SELECT a.board_id, a.board_title_en, a.board_title_kh, a.board_html_en, a.board_html_kh, a.board_view_count, a.created_date, b.is_banner_display, c.category_code, c.category_name FROM bbs_board a LEFT JOIN bbs_board_newsevent b ON b.board_id = a.board_id INNER JOIN bbs_category c ON c.category_code = a.category_code WHERE c.parent_category_code = '004' AND a.is_deleted = 0
AND ( a.board_title_en ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{dataGridDTO.searchKeyword}, '%') OR a.board_html_en ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{dataGridDTO.searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY a.created_date DESC
LIMIT #{dataGridDTO.pageSize} OFFSET #{dataGridDTO.start}
